The change is complete and the test suite is green.

## Summary

The business-day rule for owner registration lives in a single utility class, `BusinessDay.rollForward`, shared by all three consumers (`DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate`, `CheckDailyOwnerLimit`, `DailyOwnerRegistrations`). It previously rolled forward over weekends only.

I extended it in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/BusinessDay.java` to also skip the fixed public-holiday list (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28): the roll-forward loop now continues past any date that is a Saturday, Sunday, **or** a listed holiday until it reaches the next non-holiday business day. Because all three consumers share this one method, the holiday rule now applies to the effective registration date and both daily-bucket rules at once. I also updated the class Javadoc to reflect the new behavior.

`./mvnw test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (the `AcceptanceTest.coreDefaultDateIsBusinessDay` invariant test, whose `toBusinessDay` helper already accounted for the same holiday set).
